headline: RapWire 24/7: evening hip-hop and GTA VI briefing — Sept. 28, 2026 5 PM
body: A five-slide verified evening news carousel covers a VMA win by Cardi B and Kehlani, Drake’s surprise Houston appearance with Karol G, Nicki Minaj’s tribute to Mighty Sparrow, the ongoing JAŸ-Z IN 8 documentary rollout, and Game Informer’s GTA VI cover package. Each story is separately source-grounded with two reputable references, uses original editorial illustration, and includes concise context about what happened and why it matters.

caption:
1. Cardi B and Kehlani took home Best Hip-Hop at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards for “Safe.” The win beat a field that included Drake, Don Toliver, Megan Thee Stallion, Travis Scott and Tyler, The Creator, giving both artists a fresh major-award moment. @iamcardib @kehlani

2. Drake surprised the crowd at Karol G’s Houston show and joined her for the first live performance of their collaboration “Ahí.” He also stayed for “Janice STFU” and “One Dance,” turning a Karol G tour stop into an unexpected shared headline moment. @champagnepapi @karolg

3. Nicki Minaj paid tribute to Mighty Sparrow after the calypso legend died in New York at 91, sharing a message that called him an icon. Born Slinger Francisco, Sparrow shaped Caribbean music across seven decades and leaves a legacy spanning hundreds of songs and dozens of albums. @nickiminaj

4. Jay-Z and Rick Rubin’s eight-part music documentary series continues its weekly rollout on HBO and Max. The conversations move through the rapper’s catalog, influences and creative process, giving viewers an unusually close look at how the songs were built. @jayz @rickrubin

5. Game Informer’s next cover story puts Grand Theft Auto VI front and center with a 14-page feature, exclusive Rockstar interview details and 12 new screenshots. The package focuses on Vice City and Leonida, including weather, wildlife and Rockstar’s effort to make the world feel unmistakably Florida. @rockstargames

@Rapwire247
